keyEvents.text: Goal! Lecce 0, Genoa 1. Milutin Osmajic (Genoa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Junior Messias.
Goal! Lecce 0, Genoa 2. Junior Messias (Genoa) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Stephan El Shaarawy.
Delay in match (Genoa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lecce 1, Genoa 2. Youssef Maleh (Lecce) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match (Genoa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lecce. Mohamed Kaba replaces Olaf Gorter.
Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lecce. Amar Fatah replaces Joël Monteiro.
Substitution, Genoa. Kingsley Ehizibue replaces Samuel Wiafe.
Substitution, Genoa. Vítinha replaces Stephan El Shaarawy.
Hamed Traoré (Genoa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jamil Siebert (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lecce. Omri Gandelman replaces Youssef Maleh.
Substitution, Lecce. Ali Dembélé replaces Nikola Stulic.
Substitution, Lecce. Paco Esteban replaces Konan N’Dri.
Substitution, Genoa. Djibril Sow replaces Hamed Traoré.
Substitution, Genoa. Lorenzo Colombo replaces Milutin Osmajic.
Substitution, Genoa. Ethan Meichtry replaces Junior Messias.
